pro.title: Add an image in Phoenix Pro
pro.context: This walkthrough starts with the first-website practice project open in Design Mode. Your computer’s file picker opens outside the recording.
pro.label: Phoenix Pro walkthrough: choose a photo from your device and set its description in first-website

metadata.name: Add an image in Phoenix Pro using Design Mode
metadata.description: Replace the picture in the first-website practice project using Phoenix Pro. Open Image Gallery in Design Mode, select a photo from your device, set its alt description in Element Properties, and save.

instructions: Phoenix Pro: open first-website in Design Mode for a larger preview.
Click the grey pen to turn on Edit Mode. An orange pen means editing is on.
Click the hills. The Image Gallery opens at the bottom.
Click Select from device, then choose photo.jpg in your file picker.
If asked where to save the picture, enter images and click OK.
Click the photo, close the Image Gallery, then click img to open its properties.
Scroll inside Element Properties to show all the Attributes.
Replace the alt text with a short description. Press Enter to apply it.
Click Save File in the narrow toolbar on the left. Stay in Design Mode.
Click the orange pen to turn editing off and check the finished page.
Your photo and description are saved. The image is inside your project.

community.title: Add an image in Phoenix Code Community
community.context: This walkthrough uses the free Community features. It starts with photo.jpg already copied into the first-website project’s images folder.
community.label: Community walkthrough: replace an image using Highlight Mode in first-website

metadata.name: Add an image in Phoenix Code Community using Highlight Mode
metadata.description: Replace the picture in the first-website practice project using free Community features. Use Highlight Mode to locate the image in HTML, select the whole img tag, replace its filename and alt description, and save.

instructions: Community: choose Highlight Mode from the arrow beside the pen.
Click the hills in Live Preview. The editor finds the image tag.
In the editor, select the whole image tag before replacing it.
Paste the new tag. Use your picture filename and a short description.
Save with Ctrl+S (Windows/Linux) or Cmd+S (Mac). Your photo is in the page.
